The cuboid measures 1.5m by 1.5m by 1m. It is filled with water.
The cylinder is empty. It has radius 80cm and height 90cm.
Water flows from the cuboid to the cylinder until the cylinder is full.
The water flows through the pipe at a rate of 35cm3 per second.
